ModMetaData.name: Spidercat Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Replaces vanillaexpanded.vgeneticse's GR_Spidercat art (south/ east/north facings only - the GR_Dessicated_Spidercat corpse texture stays on donor art) with custom generated art per the 2026-09-10 sitting ruling: "spindly alien-like spidercat thing" for the Ash'karr wasteland cast. LABEL/ ART ONLY - no defName touched, no Defs, no Patches, loose Textures/ only, same relative path (Things/Pawn/Animal/Insectoid/Spidercat/ GR_Spidercat_<facing>) the donor uses so this mod's later load order wins the same-path resolution.
Donor ships this art as loose PNGs already (not AssetBundle-packed), so this is a plain file overwrite by load order - the loose-PNG-over-AssetBundle question ART_REGEN_WAVE1_WIRE_IN_1 answered doesn't even apply here.
